hxfiledialog.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit file dialog API. It includes support for the Open File, Save File, Save As File, and New File dialogs.

Function Documentation

HxResult HxFileDialog ( const char *  pTitle,
HxFileDialogAttributes_t  attributes,
const char *  pFilenameIn,
char **  hFilenameOut,
HxFileDialogButtonType_t *  pButton 
)

Show a file dialog and wait for user selection.

This function is called to create and show a file dialog. It is used to display a "Save", "Save As", "Open" and "New" file dialog.

If pTitle is NULL, the title of the dialog is set to "Save", "Save As" or "Open", based on the attributes.

Note that if a file is selected, a new buffer will be allocated to store the filename. The CALLER is responsible for free'ing this buffer.

Parameters:
pTitle IN: Title of the window; if NULL, display the default title
attributes IN: Attributes of the file dialog
pFilenameIn IN: Initial filename, or NULL
hFilenameOut OUT: Pointer to var to receive address of newly malloc'ed buffer containing filename. If file selection succeedes, the CALLER is responsible for free'ing this buffer. Set to NULL if user cancels the file dialog.
pButton OUT: Index of the button that was pressed
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK on success, HX_MEMORY_ERROR on memory allocation error. *hFilenameOut is set to NULL if there is an error.

HxResult HxFileDialogCustom ( const char *  pTitle,

const char *  pFilenameIn,
char **  hFilenameOut,
HxFileDialogButtonType_t *  pButton 
)

Show a custom file dialog and wait for user selection.

This function is called to create and show a custom file dialog. It is used to display a "Save", "Save As", "Open", and "New" file dialog, with a custom label and/or buttons.

If pTitle is NULL, the title of the dialog is set to "Save", "Save As" or "Open", based on the attributes. Similarly, if pLabel, pButtonLabel1, or pButtonLabel2 are NULL, then the default strings associated with the file dialog are used.

Note that if a file is selected, a new buffer will be allocated to store the filename. The CALLER is responsible for free'ing this buffer.

Parameters:
pTitle IN: Title of the window; if NULL, display the default title
pLabel IN: Label next to the text field, or NULL
pButtonLabel1 IN: Text for the leftmost button, or NULL
pButtonLabel2 IN: Text for the second button, or NULL
attributes IN: Attributes of the file dialog
filter IN: File filter function
context IN: User data passed as first parameter to filter
pFilenameIn IN: Initial filename, or NULL
hFilenameOut OUT: Pointer to var to receive address of newly malloc'ed buffer containing filename. If file selection succeedes, the CALLER is responsible for free'ing this buffer. Set to NULL if user cancels the file dialog.
pButton OUT: Index of the button that was pressed
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK on success, HX_MEMORY_ERROR on memory allocation error. *hFilenameOut is set to NULL if there is an error.
